summary: Admin Panel backend testing complete. Created /app/backend/tests/test_admin_panel.py with 19 tests covering stats, list users, promote/demote, block/unblock, self-protection (cannot demote/block/delete self), blocked-user login rejection, blocked-user existing-token rejection on /api/auth/me, cascade delete of articles/comments/likes, and admin comments listing. All 19 admin tests PASS plus 25 regression tests from test_blog_api.py (3 conditional skips).

admin_panel_results.GET /api/admin/stats: PASS - returns AdminStats with all 6 counters, admin-only (403 teacher, 401 anon)
admin_panel_results.GET /api/admin/users: PASS - returns AdminUserOut list with articles_count/comments_count/is_blocked, no password_hash or _id leaks, admin-only
admin_panel_results.PUT /api/admin/users/{id}: PASS - promote teacher->admin, demote admin->teacher, block, unblock all work; 404 on unknown; 403 for teachers
admin_panel_results.DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}: PASS - cascades delete of author's articles, comments on them (verified missing from /api/admin/comments), and likes; 400 self, 404 unknown, 403 teacher
admin_panel_results.GET /api/admin/comments: PASS - returns all comments, admin-only, no _id leak
admin_panel_results.Self-protection: PASS - admin cannot demote self (400 'لا يمكنك تنزيل صلاحياتك بنفسك'), block self (400 'لا يمكنك حظر نفسك'), delete self (400 'لا يمكنك حذف نفسك')
admin_panel_results.Blocked user login: PASS - returns 403 with Arabic 'تم تعليق حسابك. تواصلي مع الإدارة.'
admin_panel_results.Blocked user existing token on /api/auth: PASS - get_current_user rejects with 403 'تم تعليق حسابك' even if token was issued before block

regression_results.article_update: PASS (all 8 PUT tests incl. admin edit any, validation 422)
regression_results.likes: PASS (toggle; requires-auth SKIPPED when no articles to anonymously target)

critical_code_review_comments: Admin endpoints correctly protected via require_admin dependency; stats/list/update/delete/comments all enforce 403 for non-admin.
Self-protection checks in admin_update_user and admin_delete_user are implemented before applying any mutation - good ordering.
is_blocked check in get_current_user (line 178) correctly rejects already-authenticated sessions after admin blocks them, returning 403 with Arabic detail - matches spec.
Cascade delete in admin_delete_user removes articles, comments, and likes by user_id - confirmed by cascade test (article 404, comment id not in /api/admin/comments).
Minor (non-blocking): admin_update_user could also reject is_blocked=True on the admin's last remaining admin via a count guard; currently only self-block is prevented. Not a spec requirement.
Minor: /api/admin/users O(N*2) DB calls (one count per user for articles + comments). Fine for current scale; a single aggregation pipeline would be more efficient if user count grows.
Pre-existing: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown (should migrate to lifespan) - unchanged from iteration 2.
